milestones.title: The Laugher
milestones.whatThisMeans: Shared surprise and joy — timing, surprise, and laughter are building blocks of humour and connection.
milestones.storyPrompt: Write a warm 3-paragraph story for {parentName} about hearing {childName} laugh at {ageMonths} months. Include who was there and what sparked the moment. No medical advice. No age comparison language.

milestones.title: The First Smile
milestones.whatThisMeans: This is the beginning of social communication — your child's expressions are starting to affect the world around them.
milestones.storyPrompt: Write a warm 3-paragraph story for {parentName} about witnessing {childName}'s first smile at {ageMonths} months. Include who was there, the time of day, and the mood in the room. No medical advice. No age comparison language.

milestones.storyPrompt: Write a warm 3-paragraph story for {parentName} about {childName}'s first word at {ageMonths} months.

milestones.storyPrompt: Write a warm 3-paragraph story for {parentName} about {childName} naming a feeling at {ageMonths} months.

milestones.title: The Big Kid
milestones.whatThisMeans: A gentle close to the baby years — their brain is nearly adult-sized and a new chapter begins.
milestones.storyPrompt: Write a warm 4-paragraph journey summary for {parentName} about {childName} turning three at {ageMonths} months, looking toward preschool. No age comparison language.
